title: DHEA-carbamate derivatives as dual cholinesterase inhibitors: Integration of enzymatic and biomolecular interactions in Alzheimer's disease.
authors: Nar, Kubra; Erdagi, Sevinc Ilkar; Ozbagci, Duygu Inci
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DHEA-氨基甲酸酯衍生物作为阿尔茨海默病胆碱酯酶抑制剂，虽含DNA结合实验和分子对接，但核心是酶抑制与神经保护，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，方法仅为常规对接，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by cognitive decline and cholinergic dysfunction. Given the limitations of current acetylcholinesterase (AChE) and butyrylcholinesterase (BuChE) inhibitors, novel multi-target drug candidates are urgently needed. In this study, a series of DHEA-carbamate derivatives were rationally designed and synthesized to integrate cholinesterase inhibition with potential neuroprotective and pharmacokinetic advantages. The synthesized compounds were characterized via NMR and HRMS, and their inhibitory activities were determined by Ellman's method. While native DHEA displayed negligible cholinesterase inhibition (IC(50) > 75 muM), carbamate derivatization significantly enhanced potency. D1 exhibited the highest AChE selectivity (IC(50) = 0.09 muM, SI = 424), D8 showed the strongest BuChE inhibition (IC(50) = 0.1 muM), and D9 emerged as a dual-action inhibitor (AChE IC(50) = 0.15 muM; BuChE IC(50) = 0.7 muM). Molecular docking supported the observed in vitro activities, particularly the binding affinity of D1 toward AChE (-9.2 kcal/mol). Beyond enzyme inhibition, the most potent compounds (D1, D8, D9) were evaluated for their ability to mitigate H(2)O(2)-induced cytotoxicity in HT-22 neuronal cells. D9 exhibited the strongest protective effect, restoring cell viability up to 78 %. Additionally, the antioxidant activities of D9 were confirmed through DPPH scavenging and ferrous chelation assays, where it again demonstrated superior activity. DNA and HSA interaction studies revealed favorable binding properties, suggesting genomic stability and prolonged systemic availability. ADMET predictions indicated desirable pharmacokinetic profiles, including blood-brain barrier permeability. These results highlight the therapeutic relevance of hybrid steroid-carbamate scaffolds that combine cholinesterase inhibition, antioxidant capacity, and cellular neuroprotection, offering a promising strategy for next-generation AD drug development.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，以认知功能下降和胆碱能功能障碍为特征。鉴于当前乙酰胆碱酯酶（acetylcholinesterase, AChE）和丁酰胆碱酯酶（butyrylcholinesterase, BuChE）抑制剂的局限性，迫切需要新型多靶点候选药物。本研究合理设计并合成了一系列DHEA-氨基甲酸酯衍生物，旨在整合胆碱酯酶抑制活性与潜在的神经保护和药代动力学优势。合成化合物通过NMR和HRMS进行表征，其抑制活性采用Ellman法测定。天然DHEA显示出可忽略的胆碱酯酶抑制活性（IC(50) > 75 muM），而氨基甲酸酯衍生化显著增强了效力。D1表现出最高的AChE选择性（IC(50) = 0.09 muM，SI = 424），D8显示出最强的BuChE抑制作用（IC(50) = 0.1 muM），D9则成为双作用抑制剂（AChE IC(50) = 0.15 muM；BuChE IC(50) = 0.7 muM）。分子对接支持观察到的体外活性，特别是D1对AChE的结合亲和力（-9.2 kcal/mol）。除酶抑制外，对最具潜力的化合物（D1、D8、D9）进行了评估，以考察其缓解HT-22神经元细胞中H(2)O(2)诱导细胞毒性的能力。D9表现出最强的保护作用，将细胞活力恢复至78%。此外，通过DPPH清除和亚铁螯合实验确认了D9的抗氧化活性，其再次表现出优越性能。DNA和HSA相互作用研究揭示了有利的结合特性，提示基因组稳定性和延长全身可用性。ADMET预测表明其具有理想的药代动力学特征，包括血脑屏障通透性。这些结果突显了杂合类固醇-氨基甲酸酯骨架的治疗相关性，其结合了胆碱酯酶抑制、抗氧化能力和细胞神经保护作用，为下一代AD药物开发提供了有前景的策略。
